profile.name: Vaibhav Yadav
profile.roleSecondary: AI Agents . SaaS Implementation · BI & Analytics
profile.tagline: I sit at the intersection of AI, business process, and data  — implementing enterprise SaaS platforms, building BI dashboards that drive real decisions, and shipping AI agents that automate the rest.
bio: I'm an Associate Product Implementation Consultant at EngiNeo Solutions, working where business process, technology, data, and automation meet.

My core work spans enterprise SaaS implementation across HRMS and Finance — requirement gathering, business process analysis, product configuration, data migration, SQL validation, UAT and stakeholder collaboration, through to post-go-live support — on platforms like Keka HRMS and Happay Expense Management.

Alongside implementation consulting, I've built a strong practice in data analytics and business intelligence with Power BI, SQL, Python, DAX, Power Query and Excel — most recently an executive BI dashboard for 7H Hospitality that turns Microsoft Business Central data into decision-ready financial and operational KPIs.

I'm also actively exploring AI and Generative AI — hands-on with FastAPI, LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, multi-agent systems, MCP and REST APIs — because I'd rather build a working AI application than just talk about one.

stats.label: Platforms implemented — Keka HRMS, Happay & Shipsy WMS

points: Lead requirement gathering and business-process analysis across enterprise SaaS implementations spanning HRMS and Finance — including Keka HRMS and Happay Expense Management.
Translate business requirements into practical product configuration, aligning platform capability with real client process.
Own data migration and SQL validation end-to-end, guaranteeing accurate, reliable data at go-live.
Coordinate UAT cycles and stakeholder collaboration across business and technical teams through sign-off.
Provide post-go-live support — stabilizing systems, resolving issues, and keeping clients live after handover.
Build Python-based reporting tools and interactive dashboards layered on top of implementation data for real-time insight.
Part of EngiNeo's collaboration with Shipsy.io, implementing the Shipsy WMS for Reliance Retail — extending the practice from HRMS/Finance into warehouse operations.
Supported requirements gathering and stakeholder reporting across active client engagements.
Translated business needs into structured documentation to speed up delivery handoffs.

projects.name: Shipsy WMS Implementation — Reliance Retail

Extending the rollout into semi-automated and automated warehouse operations

projects.name: Multi-Tenant HRMS Platform
projects.description: A production-grade HR Management System built from scratch as an independent engineering exercise, separate from client implementation work — multi-tenant by design, with a generic RBAC engine, a configurable policy engine, and a reusable approval-workflow engine driving leave, onboarding and offboarding.
highlights: Tenant-isolated architecture with resource:action:scope permission model
Config-driven policy engine — attendance & overtime rules change without code
MCP integrations wiring HR workflows into Notion, Linear & Atlassian

Edge and bankroll-sizing calculations grounded in real market data
Iterated through multiple architecture versions toward a production build
